cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. National cadastral coverage was about 33% in October 2026.
cells.note: A March 2025 joint order declared Sao Vicente a cadastred area, after a project that built a property rights information system and cadastred Sal, Boa Vista and Maio. Coverage was about a third of the country in October 2026, so not 4.
